finalText:
Build's clean — exit 0, 0 errors. The remaining 8 warnings are genuine deprecation noise from the bump (not causing failures).

Two real bugs from the dependency bump, both in the link stage:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but this code still read `options.retries` (now `undefined`), so `.toFixed(0)` threw. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict boolean check only handled `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled (matching the old loader's default behavior).
